items.title: Choose the opening reflection deadline
items.detail: September 13 or September 14 at 11:59 p.m.

items.title: Authorize the prepared Canvas course
items.detail: Confirm that the course shell and opening assignments can be published.

items.title: Choose the Delta blues listening selections
items.detail: Select the tracks and decide where students will access them.

items.title: Test the first three course-pack readings
items.detail: Open each reading in student context and confirm that access works.

items.title: Choose the Scholar Exam opening plan
items.detail: Set the release timing and publication sequence.

items.title: Finish the dossier rules
items.detail: Decide acceptance, resubmission, and late-work rules.

items.title: Settle the BUEN syllabus decision bundle
items.detail: Confirm units, final-period use, grading thresholds, career-profile deadlines, late work, participation, and current policy language.

items.title: Confirm student access to the BUEN syllabus
items.detail: Open the SharePoint link with an enrolled-student account or equivalent view.

items.title: Verify BUEN Canvas in Student View
items.detail: Check course 13940 for navigation, visibility, and opening-week access.

items.title: Decide the old portal's future
items.detail: Choose retirement, redirect, or clearly labeled archive status for the previous portal.

items.title: Make the publication-ready BUEN syllabus
items.detail: Apply the decision bundle and produce a clean student-facing edition.

items.title: Reconcile the FRST public course record
items.detail: Resolve the remaining wording and date mismatch across student-facing surfaces.

items.title: Finish first-day Canvas polish
items.detail: Tighten navigation and verify front-page links.

items.title: Synchronize the debate title and roster handoff
items.detail: Make the student-facing labels and workflow agree.

items.title: Finish the opening source kit
items.detail: Verify remaining sources and create the reusable daily worksheet.

items.title: Draft ten Canvas-ready BUEN modules
items.detail: Build them after the syllabus decisions are settled.

items.title: Make unsafe uncertainty block publication
items.detail: Add a release check so unresolved privacy questions cannot slip onto the public site.

items.title: Put the BUEN syllabus and Canvas links on HQ
items.detail: Student-facing buttons are live.

items.title: Give the BUEN card a relevant image
items.detail: The experiential-learning image is live with source credit.

items.title: Confirm common-event details
items.detail: Verify speakers, titles, locations, and tutors.

items.title: Write FRST teaching briefs
items.detail: Develop them in instructional order.

items.title: Prepare daily HIST teaching frames
items.detail: For each session: question, evidence, answer, counterevidence, and visual.

items.title: Develop the November 10 ethics session
items.detail: Return to it after the course spine is stable.

items.title: Create a private backup strategy
items.detail: Choose a remote only after a privacy scan.
